name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.6: settlement mismatches now raise an alert and email the operator. A mismatch (the recomputed weight-derived total or any line disagreeing with what the app charged) was only written to the settlement row and a console warning, so the money-path signal reached nobody. It now raises a critical settlement_mismatch alert keyed to the orderId and emails the operator on the same recipient rule as complaints, via a new plain operator-alert template. Replayed settlements do not re-alert, since a repost is the same fact about the same order. Cumulative over v6.5.
